---
name: Ethics Concern
about: Report a bias, safety, or governance issue
title: "[ETHICS] "
labels: ethics, priority
---

## Concern Type

- [ ] Model bias (demographic, historical, representation)
- [ ] Privacy violation or data governance issue
- [ ] Safety concern (clinical misuse, crisis protocols)
- [ ] Informed consent issue
- [ ] Algorithmic fairness (disparate impact)
- [ ] Other: ___

## Location

File / notebook / chapter where the concern is found.

## Description

Describe the ethical concern clearly and specifically.

## Evidence

What evidence supports this concern? (metrics, citations, examples)

## Proposed Resolution

How should this be addressed?

## Urgency

- [ ] Critical (do not use in any context until fixed)
- [ ] High (needs fix before next release)
- [ ] Medium (should be addressed in next sprint)
- [ ] Low (informational, for future consideration)
